name: Effect: wine glass (body)
notes: Your playing shakes a wine glass tuned to A5 (880 Hz), and it rings along: notes that hit one of its modes make it sing. An effect for in front of any amp: no amp, no cab, auto level off. Physics: the glass rim as a thin ring (its bending modes at 1, 2.83, 5.42, 8.77 x the lowest). Simplified: every mode is shaken and heard equally. Change Lowest mode in the chain editor to tune it to your song.
